description: Buu's house: a white round house like a lying caterpillar, with a big head dome, four round segments trailing to the right, and a long round tube lying on top, fattest in the middle, with its flat front to the front left.
layout: Middle: the lower body lies along x, z -1.1 to 1.1, straight on the ground with no stone base: a big white head dome (x -3.04 to -0.64, 1.6 high) and four round segments to its right. Their heights rise from the head to segment 3, and the tail is the smallest: segment 1 x -1.24 to 0.36 (1.25 high), segment 2 x -0.14 to 1.56 (1.38), segment 3 x 1.06 to 2.86 (1.48), tail x 2.36 to 3.76 (1). Segment 1 goes 0.6 into the head (-1.24 < -0.64), and each segment presses 0.5 into the next: they join. Front left: two flat white feet lie on the ground and stick out to the left of the head, one at z 0.75 turned 25 degrees to point to the front left, one at z 0.1 pointing left. Top: a long round white tube lies on the head, 3.9 long. It runs to the back right, 47 degrees from x, and its back end rises 7 degrees. Its front is cut flat, like a sausage cut with a knife: a full flat round face, 1.06 wide, at the front left (center x -2.56, z 0.77, about 2.11 high). Nothing comes out of it and it is not hollow. Right behind the cut the tube is already nearly full (1.56 wide at 0.4 m), then it swells to its fattest part, 1.7 wide, in the middle (x -1.14, z -0.75), then ends in a big round back. It is a short front egg and a main egg (each 2 domes back to back, laid along the tube); the cut face is the flat base of a dome pointing back, whose rest is hidden inside. Its lowest point is 0.14 into the top of the head, so it sits on the head; its back hangs over segment 1, 0.66 above it. The round door hole on the head, the hole in the cut face of the tube, and all the small round windows are not shapes: they will be painted in textures.
